edukimi.title: Faculty of Education
edukimi.fullDesc: At the Faculty of Education in Prishtina, Green Up carried out the complete installation of a passenger elevator — from mounting the guide rails and counterweight in the shaft to the new stainless steel cabin with mirror. The work was performed to European EN 81-20/50 standards and delivered with full technical documentation.

banimi.title: Residential Building
banimi.desc: Passenger elevators for a multi-storey building
banimi.fullDesc: Installation of modern passenger elevators in a multi-storey residential building. The project included the complete shaft installation and automatic landing doors, with marble-clad entrances — a combination of safety, comfort and aesthetics.

arkitektura.title: Faculty of Architecture
arkitektura.fullDesc: For the Faculty of Architecture in Prishtina, Green Up installed a vertical platform lift with a metal-and-glass structure, providing barrier-free access for people with limited mobility. The solution was carefully integrated into the existing interior.

juridiku.title: Faculty of Law
juridiku.fullDesc: At the Faculty of Law in Prishtina, an inclined wheelchair platform was installed that travels along the existing staircase without structural changes. The platform folds away when not in use and is easily operated by remote control — see the videos of it in operation.

trashegimia.title: Cultural Heritage House
trashegimia.desc: Outdoor platform at a historic building
trashegimia.fullDesc: Installation of an outdoor platform lift at a cultural heritage house. The dark metal-and-glass structure was chosen to respect the building's historic architecture while providing equal access for all visitors.
services: Structure adapted to a historic building

filologjiku.title: Faculty of Philology
filologjiku.fullDesc: Installation of a new passenger elevator at the Faculty of Philology in Prishtina. The photos show the installation phase — the cabin with protective covering and the control panel during configuration — part of our careful assembly and commissioning process.

dumbwaiter.title: Service Lift (Dumbwaiter)
dumbwaiter.fullDesc: Installation of a compact service lift (dumbwaiter) for fast and safe transport of goods between floors. The stainless steel cabin and display control panel make it simple and hygienic to use — ideal for restaurants, hotels and businesses. See the video of it in operation.

items.q: How long does elevator installation take?
items.a: Installation time depends on the type and complexity. Usually a standard elevator requires 3-7 working days. Home lift elevators can be installed in 1-2 days.
Yes, all our elevators come with a minimum 2-year warranty. Some models have up to 5 years warranty on mechanical parts.

items.q: What kind of maintenance is needed?
items.a: We recommend regular maintenance every 6 months. This includes checking safety systems, lubricating moving parts and testing functionality.
Our main focus is Kosovo, where we offer full coverage. For projects in the region, contact us and we will assess the possibility case by case.

items.q: What elevator brands do you sell?
items.a: We work with certified European and international manufacturers, selected for quality and safety. All products carry CE certification and meet EN 81-20/50 standards.
Yes! Our 24/7 service is always active. You can contact us at any time of day or night for emergencies.

items.q: How much does home lift installation cost?
items.a: Prices vary depending on specifications and dimensions. We offer free consultation and no-obligation quote. Contact us for a personalized price.

items.q: Can an elevator be installed in existing buildings?
items.a: Yes, we have extensive experience installing elevators in existing buildings without prior planning, finding optimal technical solutions.
Absolutely. All our elevators are certified according to European standards EN 81-20/50, harmonized under Directive 2014/33/EU, and undergo regular inspection by competent bodies.

items.q: How can I request a quote?
items.a: You can contact us through the online form, phone, or visit our office in Fushë Kosovë. We offer free on-site consultation and assessment.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy explains how Green Up ("we") collects, uses and protects your personal data when you visit our website or contact us. We process data in accordance with Law No. 06/L-082 on Protection of Personal Data of the Republic of Kosovo, which is aligned with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

body: Rr. Hyzri Talla pn, 12000 Fushë Kosovë, Republic of Kosovo

Contact form: your name, email address, phone number (optional) and your message. We use this data solely to respond to your request (legal basis: pre-contractual steps or our legitimate interest in answering inquiries).

Technical data: when you visit the site, our hosting provider (Vercel Inc., USA) automatically processes your IP address and standard server access data necessary for the operation and security of the site.
Aggregate statistics: we use Vercel Analytics, a cookie-free analytics service that does not identify you personally and does not track your activity across other websites.
Contact form messages are sent via the Resend service (Plus Five Five, Inc., USA) and delivered to our email address. The content of your message is processed only for this purpose.

Our site contains Google Maps (Google LLC, USA). The map does NOT load automatically — it is activated only after you click the "Load map" button. Only then are connections made to Google's servers and cookies may be set by Google. Your choice is stored locally in your browser.
Our virtual assistant runs entirely in your browser with pre-prepared answers. Conversations are not stored on our servers and are not sent to any third party.

The site uses only technically necessary cookies/local storage: your language preference (NEXT_LOCALE) and your choice about loading maps. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies, which is why we do not display a cookie banner.
We keep contact messages only as long as necessary to handle your request and meet our legal obligations, then delete them.

You have the right to request access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and to object to the processing of your personal data. For any request, write to us at info@greenup-ks.com.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Information and Privacy Agency (AIP) of the Republic of Kosovo.
We may update this policy as needed. The current version is always published on this page.
